svg.title: Instance similarity matrix and one full softmax
svg.desc: A four by four similarity matrix of dot products between the vectors a1 b1 c1 d1, with the diagonal excluded, positives highlighted and impostors shown. To the right the row of anchor a1 is exponentiated, summed, normalized and turned into a loss value of 0.34.
svg.text: gray diagonal = removed by the tril and triu trick
Anchor a1: its row, in full
Same for rows b1, c1, d1:

g.text: Instance loss = mean of all anchors, all timestamps
